name: Brunton House and Cottages
accommodation: Brunton House (sleeps 16) and eight cottages sleeping 2 to 8
suitableFor: Couples, families, large groups and dog owners
parking: Ample parking with EV charging points
beachAccess: Beadnell Bay about 2 miles; Beadnell and Embleton about 5 minutes' drive
confirmedFeatures: Log-burning stoves, welcome basket, EV charging, group venue with commercial kitchen
overview: Self-catering cottages on an organic farm at Brunton, near Embleton, with views over Beadnell Bay. There are eight cottages plus a large house sleeping 16, and several properties accept dogs. Beadnell Bay is about two miles away, around five minutes' drive.
surfTripFit: Five minutes' drive from the bay with plenty of parking and EV charging, it suits groups and families who want space.
